active_crises_input.title: G-10 Urban Flood & Suspected Water Main Burst

steps.description: Validated 3 crisis inputs for prompt injection, schema conformance, and coordinate bounds. All inputs passed safety checks.

guardrail_checks.detail: No injection sequences detected in any citizen report text.
All 3 coordinate pairs fall within Pakistan bounding box (23.5°N–37.0°N, 60.5°E–77.5°E).
All crisis objects match CrisisEvent schema.

steps.description: Fused 7 signal sources across 3 crises. Parsed Urdu citizen text, extracted GPS zones, and ingested satellite and sensor feeds.

arguments.text: جی ٹین میں شدید بارش سے سڑکیں زیرِ آب آ گئی ہیں۔ پانی گھروں میں داخل ہو رہا ہے۔
I think it's actually a water main that burst near the G-10 markaz, not flooding from rain.

result.contradiction_detail: Contradicts majority flood reports. Possible water-main hypothesis.

result.forecast_6h: No relief expected. Peak at 51°C by 14:00 local

fusion_summary.contradiction_detail: G-10: 12 citizen posts say 'flood', 2 say 'water main burst'. PMD confirms 52mm/hr rainfall, supporting flood hypothesis. Water-main theory retained as secondary.

steps.description: Scored credibility for each crisis signal stream. Cross-referenced citizen reports against physical sensors to detect misinformation.

result.sensor_corroboration: CONFIRMED — PMD rainfall 52mm/hr + water gauge 145cm above threshold supports flooding
flags: Minor contradiction: 2/14 posts suggest water-main, retained as secondary hypothesis

result.sensor_corroboration: CONFIRMED — PMD heat index 54°C matches heatstroke reports
CONFIRMED — NASA FIRMS detected 4 thermal anomalies with FRP 168.3 MW

steps.description: Classified all 3 crises with type, severity, affected metrics, and evolution predictions.

classifications.spread_risk: HIGH — upstream water rising at 2cm/hr, overflow into G-9 expected by T+6h
classifications.uncertainty_range: ±8% on population estimate due to incomplete census data

classifications.spread_risk: MEDIUM — entire Sindh lowlands under same thermal dome
HIGH — 18km/h winds pushing fire toward Trail 5 residential edge

steps.description: Queried NDMA historical incident database for analogous events to inform planning.

analogous_events.title: Nala Lai Flash Flood
analogous_events.lessons: Dewatering pumps deployed late; pre-position at known chokepoints

analogous_events.title: G-10 Monsoon Overflow
analogous_events.lessons: I.J. Principal Road became impassable; detour via Faisal Avenue effective

steps.description: Allocated constrained resources across 3 concurrent crises. Detected 2 resource conflicts and resolved via severity-weighted prioritization.

crisis-flood-g10.justification: CRITICAL severity + highest affected population density + active water rise

crisis-heat-hyderabad.justification: HIGH severity + largest raw affected population (95K) + heat mortality risk

crisis-fire-margalla.justification: HIGH severity but lower immediate population density. Fire brigade is exclusive resource.

conflicts_detected.resolution: Allocated to crisis-flood-g10 (CRITICAL > HIGH severity). Margalla fire uses CDA forest rangers as substitute.
conflicts_detected.tradeoff: Margalla fire containment delayed by ~25 minutes without dedicated rescue team.

conflicts_detected.resolution: Allocated to crisis-flood-g10 (active drowning risk outweighs heat casualties in immediate window). Hyderabad uses medical outreach vans as ambulance substitute.
conflicts_detected.tradeoff: Hyderabad ambulance response time increases from 8 to 22 minutes for critical heatstroke cases.

unmet_needs: crisis-fire-margalla needs 2 additional fire tenders — requested mutual aid from Rawalpindi Fire Station
crisis-heat-hyderabad needs 3 additional water tankers — escalated to Sindh Provincial Authority

steps.description: Verified the response plan against NDMA safety protocols and physical constraints.

warnings: Margalla fire: no dedicated rescue team assigned. Acceptable per NDMA SOP §4.2 when substitute (CDA rangers) is available.
Hyderabad: ambulance substitute (medical outreach van) lacks full trauma kit. Recommend restocking.

steps.description: Simulated coordinated response actions and predicted before/after outcomes with side effects.

result.action: Reroute via Faisal Avenue and 7th Avenue bypass. Close Khayaban-e-Iqbal to civilian traffic.
result.congestion_impact: Faisal Avenue load increases 40% — manageable within capacity

result.mitigation_effectiveness: 61.6% reduction in aggregate economic loss with intervention

side_effect_analysis.unintended_consequence: Strands ~200 commuters already on the road. Needs traffic police escort to alternate route.
side_effect_analysis.mitigation: Deploy 1 police unit for traffic escort (already allocated to G-10)

side_effect_analysis.action: Reroute water tankers from Islamabad depot to Hyderabad
side_effect_analysis.intended_effect: Provide hydration relief to 95K affected population
side_effect_analysis.unintended_consequence: Islamabad G-10 flood zone loses backup water supply capability
side_effect_analysis.mitigation: Acceptable tradeoff — G-10 has excess water (flood), not water scarcity

steps.description: Generated and dispatched tailored advisories to 6 stakeholder groups across all 3 crises.

advisories.message: 🚨 ایمرجنسی الرٹ: جی-10 میں شدید سیلابی صورتحال۔ فوری طور پر اونچی جگہ منتقل ہو جائیں۔ نالہ لئی کے قریب نہ جائیں۔ ہیلپ لائن: 1166
⚠️ شدید گرمی کا الرٹ: لطیف آباد میں درجہ حرارت 54°C۔ باہر نکلنے سے گریز کریں۔ زیادہ پانی پییں۔ قریبی کولنگ سینٹر: گورنمنٹ ہسپتال لطیف آباد۔

DISPATCH ORDER: Deploy Rescue Team Alpha to G-10/3 via Faisal Avenue (flood evac route). ETA 12 min. Dewatering pumps pre-staged at Nala Lai chokepoint. Avoid I.J. Principal Road — 30cm standing water. Coordinate with Police Unit for civilian escort.

MASS CASUALTY PREPARATION: Expect 15-25 flood-related injuries (hypothermia, drowning, lacerations) from G-10 within 2 hours. Activate overflow ward. Blood bank status: verify O-negative supply. Ambulance Unit 04 en route with first batch.

URGENT: Pre-emptive power shutoff requested for G-10 Sectors 1-3 due to flood water reaching electrical substations. Estimated restoration: T+18h after water recedes. Generators deployed to critical facilities (hospital, rescue HQ).

SITUATION BRIEF — 3 CONCURRENT CRISES ACTIVE:
1. G-10 Islamabad: CRITICAL urban flood. 45K affected. Rescue teams dispatched. ETA 12min.
2. Hyderabad Latifabad: HIGH heat emergency. 95K affected. Medical outreach deployed.
3. Margalla Hills: HIGH wildfire. 20K affected. Fire brigade + CDA rangers responding.
Resource conflicts resolved via severity-weighted allocation. Economic impact without intervention: PKR 125M/24h. With intervention: PKR 48M/24h (61.6% reduction).
Next update: T+2h.

steps.description: Demonstrated false positive handling and API fallback behavior for edge cases encountered during this run.

false_alarm_scenario.trigger: Field verification team arrives at G-10 Markaz and confirms water main burst at one intersection, but flooding from rainfall is genuine across the broader sector.
false_alarm_scenario.action_taken: Reclassified G-10 crisis: primary=urban_flood (unchanged), secondary=water_main_burst (CONFIRMED at G-10 Markaz only). No alert retraction needed — flood is genuine. Utility provider (WASA Islamabad) notified for water main repair.

log_update.corrective_action: WASA repair crew dispatched to G-10 Markaz intersection. Does not change flood response plan.

fallback_behavior_demonstrated.scenario: TomTom Traffic API returned 429 (rate limited) during Hyderabad traffic query
fallback_behavior_demonstrated.fallback_action: Loaded cached traffic snapshot from 15 minutes ago. Appended data_label: 'CACHED - TomTom (15min stale)'
fallback_behavior_demonstrated.impact: Traffic routing for Hyderabad uses slightly stale data. Acceptable for heat emergency (traffic is secondary concern).

fallback_behavior_demonstrated.scenario: NASA FIRMS API timeout (>5s) on second hotspot query for Margalla fire perimeter update
fallback_behavior_demonstrated.fallback_action: Used initial hotspot data from Step 2 (4 anomalies detected). Appended data_label: 'STALE - NASA FIRMS (13min old)'
fallback_behavior_demonstrated.impact: Fire perimeter estimate may be 10-15% outdated. Flagged for manual drone verification.
fallback_behavior_demonstrated.escalation_message: ⚠️ NASA FIRMS refresh failed. Requesting CDA drone flyover of Margalla Hills Trail 3-5 for updated fire perimeter.
